instruction: Send an itemized list of my amazon wish list to my wife via a phone text. The message should be a newline-separated list of '<product_name> => $<total_price>'. Replace <total_price> with the price of the product times its quantity in the wish list, rounded to the nearest whole number, and <product_name> with the product name. Ignore potential tax or delivery fees.
notes: Flow: read passwords, log into amazon, read the wish list, look up each wish-list product (name + price) with amazon.show_product, log into phone, find the wife's contact via phone.search_contacts(relationship="wife"), send one text with the itemized list, then complete_task without an answer. The number of wish-list items is only known at runtime; the problem models two placeholder products (product-1, product-2) consistent with the reference solution length (one show_product per item). A counter (c0..c2 with succ, wish-list-size) tracks how many items have been resolved so the send action is only enabled once every item's details are known; at runtime the agent repeats show_product for however many items exist. Message text is composed by the agent (round(price*quantity), ignore tax/delivery). Goal demands exactly one text to the wife's number containing the itemized list, and task completion last.
